verdict.rationale: incident.io documents a public REST API at api.incident.io with API-key authentication. The API reference covers endpoints, examples, rate limits and error handling, and offers a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec, with dedicated Status Page and Widget APIs alongside it. The probe's 404s on guessed OpenAPI paths do not contradict the documented spec download; they only show the spec isn't at those well-known locations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of using the API, evidence of how much of the product the API covers (e.g. incidents, on-call, workflows), a machine-discoverable OpenAPI spec at a standard path.
